description: Create a new FilmLab project. Returns the new project id and its `datenmodus`. Optionally set a title and the data mode: 'eu' keeps the project on models whose data path is proven inside the EU (lab_list_models eu: true lists them; other models are refused with alternatives), 'frei' allows every model. Omit to get the account default.

datenmodus.description: Data mode of the project: 'eu' (only EU-allowed models) or 'frei' (all models). Omit for the default

name: lab_create_project
title: Create Project
